column2: Paano mag-setup ng React Hook Form?
column4: const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { errors } } = useForm(); — i-destructure ang hook
<input {...register('email', { required: 'Email is required', pattern: { value: /^\S+@\S+$/i, message: 'Invalid email' } })} />

column2: Paano gumamit ng Yup para sa schema validation?
column4: const schema = yup.object({ name: yup.string().required() }); useForm({ resolver: yupResolver(schema) });

column2: Paano mag-validate ng form sa submission?
column4: onSubmit={handleSubmit(onValid, onInvalid)} — ang handleSubmit ang nagvo-validate
